closedFindings.summary: Bridge method/source proof did not execute a test message in a running current Pi session.
closedFindings.resolution: Added a controlled pinned-host E2E that dispatches through the loaded extension runtime and proves input, provider context, message event, settlement and exact session identity.

closedFindings.summary: Task Changes and task diff bypassed the effective protected-path policy for content introduced or changed after baseline.
closedFindings.resolution: Task projection now checks current and historical paths before bytes, emits no protected digest/stats/hunks, and fails the whole task view closed when an exact dirty-baseline comparison would require protected content.

closedFindings.summary: The shared source collector read protected untracked bytes before discarding them, and task diff recollection repeated the read.
closedFindings.resolution: Protected untracked inspection now short-circuits; a pure Git inspection plan excludes protected current/old paths before numstat/blob work; canonical working-tree hashing is policy-aware; inode regressions require zero protected reads.

closedFindings.summary: Historical rename protection was not propagated to workspace revision hashing or canonical working-tree evidence, so a protected old name could be read through its current name.
closedFindings.resolution: Rename records now share one bidirectional protection decision across workspace hashing, Git inspection and canonical evidence; historical internal-state renames are excluded; old-only and new-only inode regressions require zero content reads in source, task diff and snapshot paths.

closedFindings.summary: Task Changes rediscovered a historical internal-state rename after the shared Git inspection plan excluded it, then task diff exposed the current content.
closedFindings.resolution: Task path discovery builds an alias graph from current status and rename-aware immutable task-start-tree changes, so committed and staged aliases share protection/visibility through workspace observation and task content lookup; inode regressions prove zero reads and no canonical task file or diff authority.
